Sampling coverage of each species and habitat

Source: R/coverage.R
check_coverage.Rd

Summarises, for each species and habitat, how many of the species' sites sampled the habitat, how often the species was found there, and whether fit_isodars() would treat the habitat as used, absent or undersampled. Run it before fitting, to decide which species and habitats can be analysed and whether sites should be grouped (group_sites()).

Usage

check_coverage(
  data,
  species = NULL,
  site,
  habitat,
  abundance,
  effort = NULL,
  absent_max_count = 0,
  absent_min_sites = 5
)

Arguments

data

Long-format data: one row per species x site x habitat.

species, site, habitat, abundance, effort

Long format: names of the columns holding species (optional; without it the data are one species), site (or other replicate), habitat, abundance (counts) and sampling effort (optional; without it every row has effort 1).

absent_max_count, absent_min_sites

Thresholds for absent = "auto"; see Details.

Value

A tibble with one row per species x habitat: species (if given), habitat, n_sites (sites where the species was recorded in any habitat), n_complete (of those, sites where every habitat was sampled), n_sampled (sites where this habitat was sampled), n_occupied (sites where the species was recorded in this habitat), total_count and status ("used", "absent" or "undersampled").

See also

fit_isodars(), group_sites()

Examples

cov <- check_coverage(moorea_fish, species = "species", site = "site",
                      habitat = "habitat", abundance = "abundance")
cov[cov$status != "used", ]
#> # A tibble: 325 × 8
#>    species    habitat n_sites n_complete n_sampled n_occupied total_count status

#>  1 Abudefduf… outer_…      10         10        10          0           0 absent

#>  3 Acanthuru… barrie…       7          7         7          0           0 absent
#>  4 Acanthuru… fringi…       7          7         7          0           0 absent
#>  5 Acanthuru… barrie…       1          1         1          0           0 under…
#>  6 Acanthuru… outer_…       1          1         1          0           0 under…
#>  7 Acanthuru… barrie…       3          3         3          0           0 under…
#>  8 Acanthuru… barrie…       1          1         1          0           0 under…
#>  9 Acanthuru… fringi…       1          1         1          0           0 under…
#> 10 Acanthuru… barrie…       1          1         1          0           0 under…
